messages.text: The proposal is for R$49.00, the amount recorded as paid for the wooden watch box. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; a reply in chat won’t confirm it.
The customer confirmed request prop-e7b84637e3794a0b and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
The refund of R$49.00 has been recorded. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
Why is the refund R$49.00 instead of R$69.00?

The shop’s order records show that R$49.00 was paid for the wooden watch box, so that’s the amount the refund was based on. Refunds are for the amount actually paid for the item, and can’t be increased above that amount (refund-policy/v2/amount).
